name: Minimal White
intro: This site is about less is more. I wanted to create the style of an award winning wildlife photographer in England and I just did not figure it out… However, in my frustration, I created this minimal concept to let the viewer look …. To see more!

name: Birds
intro: My first love is capturing birds and their colorful beauty. Whenever possible, I like to show them in motion and in their natural environment.

name: People of the World
intro: People at work, at play, in celebration, in tradition, and in everyday life. Different cultures, different places, and different stories observed through my travels and camera. And the faces of the world!

name: Wildlife
intro: Over my life, I have had the privilege of traveling to Africa and seeing animals in their natural environment. We travel in the cage, and they go about their lives. We simply watch with amazement.

name: ICM – Intentional Camera Movement
intro: I came across several award winning photographers using this technique. Initially, I wanted to create an Impressionistic looking photograph. As I tried to make that happen, many other approaches evolved, and some did indeed look like Impressionistic paintings.

name: Black and White
blurb: No color just black and white photography
intro: Chicago's architecture, lakefront, river, parks, public art, and the city that continues to reinvent itself. A city more than beautiful.

name: WaterColor
intro: To enjoy photography, is to try different techniques, subjects and the spontaneity of life. I used less technique in editing these moments and pictures of Chicago to create an impression of Water Color painting.

name: Our Best Friends
intro: Mug shots of adorable loving companions. Their beauty, sweetness, and energy.

name: Nature's Beauty and Flight
intro: Nature paints pictures from her wonderful palette of colors, and the result is flowers. To help the flowers, butterflies arrive in all shapes and sizes, with as many colors and color combinations as Nature can imagine.

name: Places and Reflections
blurb: Quiet places and the water that gives them back — a city, a temple, a shoreline, mirrored.
intro: We look, we see, then we look again and find the reflection. Beautiful buildings, trees, and much more. Architecture, sculpture, and nature creating art.

name: Air & Water Show
intro: Faster than a speeding bullet, able to leap tall buildings in a single bound… No, it's the Thunderbirds and Blue Angels! Speed, acrobatics, spins, and formations. They speak for themselves.

name: Life Observed
intro: I always wonder what will be next. With camera in hand, I look for moments that often go unnoticed. Kids jumping into a lake, a statue decorated for the season, an animal smiling, or trees sharing their geometry. I encourage everyone to look and really see. You might even smile or giggle too!
